page_title: CRY 2-0 NEW | Crystal Palace v Newcastle 24/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A cross from a corner kick by Newcastle is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

90+6' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Dean Henderson was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+4' The referee signals a substitution. Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) is brought on as a substitute for Daniel Munoz.
90+4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.

90+2' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner.

90+2' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joe White (Newcastle Utd) replacing Sean Longstaff.
90' Elliot Anderson comes off the pitch to be replaced by Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd).

88' 2 - 0 Goal! Will Hughes produces a great pass that finds Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
85' 16:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 5:0.
83' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Adam Wharton and he is replaced by Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace).
83' Here comes a substitution. Eberechi Eze is given a rest as he is replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
80' The referee gives a yellow card to Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd).
78' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
78' Referee Thomas Bramall makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
77' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is punished with the yellow card.
77' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

76' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Thomas Bramall no option but to blow his whistle. Crystal Palace will take a free kick.
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordan Ayew will be replaced by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace).
73' Martin Dubravka is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace). Easy save!
72' A lofted cross from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
72' A spell of possession for Newcastle in an attempt to control the game.
70' Newcastle move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
66' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Bramall and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
65' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Jacob Murphy is replaced by Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd).
65' Substitution. Harvey Barnes walks off the pitch and Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
65' A cross from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

63' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
63' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
63' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
62' Crystal Palace win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
60' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
60' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Newcastle.
60' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
57' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.

55' 1 - 0 Goal! Jordan Ayew displays great vision and sends a pass to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
55' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
53' It's a throw-in for Crystal Palace.
52' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
52' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
50' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace).

50' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
48' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Thomas Bramall didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Flag up against Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
43' Some neat passing and movement from Newcastle as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
41' What was Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
38' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
36' Neat passing move from Crystal Palace in order to create new attacking opportunities.
33' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) heads on.
32' The free kick is taken by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), but ball is cleared.

31' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Crystal Palace win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
30' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) dribbles into the box, but Dean Henderson is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

29' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Bramall saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Newcastle, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
28' The shot by Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Martin Dubravka.
28' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

27' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for an infringement. Newcastle are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

24' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent. Crystal Palace are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
23' Martin Dubravka reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) towards the bottom left corner.

23' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Thomas Bramall with no other option than to blow for a foul. Crystal Palace have been awarded a free kick.
23' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Crystal Palace.
23' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
21' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
20' The ball is cleared after Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for Crystal Palace.

19' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

18' Crystal Palace hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.

15' Eberechi Eze picks out Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
15' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
14' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
13' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Martin Dubravka intercepts the ball.
12' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
12' Crystal Palace keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
11' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Martin Dubravka, who smothers the ball.
10' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
7' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
5' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
5' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Newcastle players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
4' The referee blows his whistle as Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in his challenge. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
4' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' Thomas Bramall blows for a foul after Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Free kick. Crystal Palace will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' Crystal Palace control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Newcastle are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
1' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle have a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Newcastle will kick the game off.
Thomas Bramall will officiate today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
